# Blake Smart Solutions

Blake Smart Solutions is a Perth-based installer providing Starlink installation, security camera installation, Ajax alarm installation, Wi-Fi solutions and data cabling services.

## Key services

- Starlink installation in Perth
- Security camera installation in Perth
- Ajax alarm installation in Perth
- Wi-Fi and data cabling services

## Starlink installation

Blake Smart Solutions provides professional Starlink installation across Perth. Standard Starlink installs start from $549 and include a quality roof mount, neat cable entry, setup and testing.

Blake Smart Solutions does not sell Starlink plans, manage Starlink accounts, or provide Starlink billing support. Customers arrange their own Starlink service and equipment.

## Security cameras

Blake Smart Solutions installs home and business security camera systems across Perth, including clean cabling, camera placement advice, setup and customer handover.

## Ajax alarms

Blake Smart Solutions installs Ajax wireless alarm systems for Perth homes and small businesses.

## Wi-Fi and data cabling

Blake Smart Solutions provides Wi-Fi improvement, access point installation and data cabling services across Perth.
